body.intent: In-process run() resolves programs on the script's PATH and relative file arguments against its working directory: cmd/rhiza/ctx.go's exec.Command(name)/exec.LookPath use the test binary's PATH (an in-process script with a fake bin/ rex reached the host's Rex and opened real sessions), and rhiza apply <file> reads relative to the process cwd, so 47 a-d scripts with fake bin/ commands and apply/apply-concurrent keep exec rhiza
